projects.name: 2haks Projects
projects.description: The home page for every app Dustin and Tripp build on 2haks.xyz. Each app gets a card showing what it does and how to use its API and CLI.
projects.author: Co-authored

projects.name: Pixel
projects.description: Draw pixel art on a 20×20 or 40×40 grid with pencil, fill, colour picker and select-and-move tools, then save it to a shared gallery or download it as a PNG.
projects.author: Dustin

projects.name: Boss Builder
projects.description: A 2D platformer where you play the boss! Build a trap-filled level, then stop the horde of AI heroes racing for the flag and earn golden coins for new traps, bosses and upgrades.
projects.author: Co-authored

projects.name: Portal Quiz
projects.description: An unofficial Portal fan game quiz: shoot a blue portal onto the right answer, then jump into the orange one. GLaDOS judges you, and Jim the tiny silent core floats along.
projects.author: Tripp

cli: quiz add --category Space --question 'What colour is Mars?' --choice Red --choice Blue --choice Green --choice White --answer A

projects.name: Portal Fan Lab
projects.description: An unofficial Portal fan game on Tripp's own Fire Raze engine: solve test chambers with a portal gun, cubes, buttons and flings, while GLaDOS judges you and Jim the tiny silent core floats along.
projects.author: Tripp
